hypothesis: The existing global float16 flag also converts the flow encoder and speaker projection. Keep those in FP32 and apply FP16 only to the CFM estimator and its noise/cache path, to test whether encoder precision caused the observed SIM degradation.
scope: New opt-in cfm_float16, default off; no changes to model weights on disk, sampling, Euler step count, output length limits, HiFT or speaker extraction.
operator_checks: Existing FP16 attention and DiT numerical parity tests; verify encoder parameters and execution stay FP32 while estimator execution/cache is FP16, and disabled defaults remain unchanged.
quality_screen: Use the original first64 tuning prompts at C1/C16/C32 and report WER/SIM/UTMOS before promotion. This precision experiment uses the existing frozen speech noninferiority contract; it does not change or retroactively rejudge the failed waveform-parity gate of prompt batching.
service_screen: Same Torch+MPS baseline config, microbatch4 and stage capacities16;64 reused tuning prompts,discard+one measured repeat.
holdout: 256 reserved IDs remain unused until final candidate selection.

pre_service_checks.gpu_test_environment: Small numerical tests ran on the campaign-owned ASR reservation, excluded from any service timing.
